title: lead.captured
description: PAYLOAD of the `lead.captured` envelope. Topic: data.lead.captured. The journey root for a person (§6.3): emitted by tracking/ingestion on a form submit, CTWA inbound, or via the Origin Connector lead.captured mapping (§3.4). The envelope's correlation_id is MINTED here (first touch) and propagated through every later event of this person (E.164 phone is king in India, §8.3). Carries the captured click IDs (fbclid/gclid/ctwa_clid) that make deterministic attribution + the CAPI signal loop possible (§11). Canonical field shape from Appendix A.

lead_id.description: GROWTH OS lead id (Appendix A). Also the origin_ref when via the Origin Connector.

person_hint.description: Raw identity hints for the Identity Graph (§8.3) to resolve/merge a person_id. PII here is hashed before any upload (§5.4); raw values never leave unhashed downstream.

source.description: Where the lead came from + the click/ad attribution keys (Appendix A). These keys are the raw material for signal dispatch (§11.3 match keys).

ad_id.description: Source ad id (Meta ad / Google ad).

ctwa_clid.description: Click-to-WhatsApp click id — keys business-messaging CAPI to the exact ad (§11.2).

destination.description: How the lead landed (Appendix A). ctwa opens the free 72h WA window (§11.2).

campaign_ref.description: GROWTH OS campaign this lead is attributed to (resolved from ad_id), if known.

form_fields.description: Captured lead-form answers (validity is a lead-scoring input §9.5: phone format/carrier, disposable email).

consent.description: DPDP consent captured at point of lead (§5.4 per-person/per-purpose). Every later WA send + audience upload checks this.

proof.description: Source/timestamp/proof ref for the consent ledger.
